ReasonforDeviation_Summary: Due to the capacity needs and the shortage of skills in municipalities the training initiatives improve on the challenges. ReasonforDeviation_Q1:
The Provincial Capacity Building Strategy for 2024/2025 was formulated for implementation. 
The sub-unit is responsible for the co-ordination of training in the province. Thus, capacity building initiatives were conducted in municipalities to strengthen the skills of municipal officials.
CorrectiveAction_Q1: None - the Department has no control over the number of capacity building interventions arranged by local municipalities.

ReasonforDeviation_Q2:
The Municipal Staff Regulations (MSR) requires all the municipal staff to become fit for purpose. Thus, the municipalities must apply at LGSETA for discretionary grant through their Works Skills Plan to capacitate officials to be able to meet the requires of their functions per the job descriptions.  The grant funding of LGSETA is allocated within a financial year and according to the Work Skills Plans of municipalities the implementation of their training needs must be address within that specific financial year. 

Hence, it put pressure on sector departments to capacitate officials to become fit for purpose and for the funding to be utilised to improved service delivery at municipal level.   This led to the over achievement of the Capacity Building indicator for Quarter 2.
OTP_Q2: Reasons for deviation to explain the overachievement is required.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3: The shortages of skills in municipalities are of great concern, especially in terms of the Municipal Staff Regulations (MSR) to be implemented.  Municipalities have requested training at the Technical IGR meeting on the 03 February 2024 and 03 November 2024 respectively. Hence we deemed it necessary to conduct the workshop for functionaries to understand what is required from CoGTA be able to report on the MSR Readiness Tool.
OTP_Q3: Year to date performance is at 714%, reflecting a huge over achievement in relation to the planned targets.  Reasons foe deviation have been provided consistently over the quarters.
